subject: [PATCH v2 4/4] mm/damon/core: use node counters instead of flushing the root memcg

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the DAMON core to use node counters instead of flushing the root memory cgroup (memcg) statistics when calculating LRU sizes for the goal's memcg on its node. This change improves performance by reducing the frequency of flush operations, which were previously unratelimited and occurred every time the goal was evaluated. The patch achieves this by leveraging a new function in lruvec_page_state() that directly reads the root memcg's LRU sizes from the node counters.
